_comment: Map a slot id to a .glb in this folder to replace the procedural placeholder. Slot ids: sword, creature:Gloria, creature:Mortimer, creature:Dot, creature:Big Rhonda, creature:Wendell, heart. Example: "sword": { "url": "models/sword.glb", "scale": 1, "position": [0, 0, 0], "rotation": [0, 0, 0], "hideProcedural": true }
